te: Noted the report on the study visits to the Ministry of Interior and the Ministry of Labour
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, noted the report on the study visit to the Ministry of Interior and the Ministry of Labour on 14 November 2024, and approved the appointment of additional advisers
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Report on the study visit to the Ministry of Interior and the Ministry of Labour, 14 November 2024
Appointment of honorary advisers to the committee and advisers to the disaster management subcommittee (additional)

te: Approved site visits to follow up on floods in 3 southern border provinces, and a study visit on water in Chaiyaphum
se: The meeting approved a committee trip to follow up on the flood situation and solutions in Yala, Pattani and Narathiwat Provinces from 16 to 18 January 2025, and a trip by the disaster management subcommittee to follow up on flood and drought management in Chaiyaphum Province from 22 to 24 January 2025
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Follow-up on the flood situation and solutions, Yala, Pattani and Narathiwat Provinces, 16–18 January 2025
The disaster management subcommittee follows up on water management to prevent floods and droughts, Chaiyaphum Province, 22–24 January 2025
Appointment of honorary advisers to the committee and advisers to the disaster management subcommittee

te: Held an anti-corruption pledge event, “Senate: No Cheating, Transparent, United Against Corruption”
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, and noted that the committee would hold an anti-corruption pledge event under the theme “Senate: No Cheating, Transparent, United Against Corruption” on 9 December 2024 at Parliament House, inviting senators, officials and parliamentary staff to declare that they do not accept corruption. It also appointed additional advisers
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
The committee held an anti-corruption pledge event, “Senate: No Cheating, Transparent, United Against Corruption”, 9 December 2024, 09.00–10.00 hrs, hall on Floor 1, Parliament House
Appointment of honorary advisers to the committee and advisers to the Subcommittee on National Disaster Management (additional)

te: Preparing a study visit to Samut Sakhon–Samut Songkhram: floods, sea-water surges and migrant workers
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, and the programme of a study visit on 28 November 2024 to Samut Sakhon and Samut Songkhram Provinces on flood prevention and solutions, monitoring high sea-water surges and care of migrant workers, such as nationality verification and the registration of identity cards for persons without Thai nationality
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

Study visit programme, 28 November 2024, Samut Sakhon and Samut Songkhram Provinces: flood prevention and solutions, monitoring high sea-water surges, migrant workers, nationality verification, and registration of identity cards for persons without Thai nationality
Appointment of honorary advisers to the committee and subcommittee advisers (additional)

te: Assigned to study 3 draft Land Allocation Acts
se: The committee was assigned to consider and study 3 draft Land Allocation Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... under Rule 119 of the Rules of Procedure of the Senate, and assigned the Subcommittee on the Development of the State Administration System and Public Sector Personnel to consider them. It also referred a petition on education to the committee concerned
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Consideration and study of 3 draft Land Allocation Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... under Rule 119 of the Rules of Procedure of the Senate B.E. 2562 (2019)
Petition asking for follow-up on disciplinary action against officials of the Ministry of Education, as alleged by the petitioner
Appointment of persons to positions in the committee (additional)

te: A petition about hardship caused by bridge construction in Ranong Province
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, and considered a petition about hardship caused to the public by the construction of a reinforced concrete bridge on Rattanakosin 200 Year Road, Ranong Province. It resolved to write to the agencies concerned asking them to help ease the hardship, and noted the programme of 2 study visits in November
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Petition about hardship to the public from the construction of a reinforced concrete bridge, Rattanakosin 200 Year Road (Ranong Provincial Administrative Organisation)
Study visit programme to the Ministry of Interior and the Ministry of Labour (14 November 2024) and to Samut Sakhon and Samut Songkhram Provinces (28 November 2024)
Appointment of a secretary, honorary advisers and subcommittee advisers

te: Study visits scheduled to the Ministry of Interior, the Ministry of Labour, and on water in Samut Songkhram–Samut Sakhon
se: The meeting noted the work of 3 subcommittees and resolved to make 2 study visits: to the Ministry of Interior and the Ministry of Labour on 14 November 2024, and on water management in Samut Songkhram and Samut Sakhon Provinces on 28 November 2024. It also appointed additional persons
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Study visit on public administration, civil service development and disaster management at the Ministry of Interior and the Ministry of Labour, 14 November 2024
Study visit on water management, Samut Songkhram and Samut Sakhon Provinces, 28 November 2024
Appointment of a secretary, academics, honorary advisers and subcommittee advisers (additional)

te: Appointment of honorary advisers, and subcommittees asked to propose work plans
se: The meeting approved the appointment of honorary advisers to the committee, asked the chairs of all 3 subcommittees to propose their work approaches at the next meeting, and appointed advisers to the Subcommittee on the Development of the State Administration System and Public Sector Personnel
it: Appointment of honorary advisers to the committee
Work approaches of all 3 subcommittees
Appointment of advisers to the Subcommittee on the Development of the State Administration System and Public Sector Personnel

te: Subcommittees formally set up, and a study visit on water management in Samut Songkhram and Samut Sakhon approved
se: The meeting approved formally setting up 3 subcommittees, appointed advisers, academics and secretaries of the committee, referred a petition about building permits in Nonthaburi Province to the committee concerned, and approved in principle a study visit on water management in Samut Songkhram and Samut Sakhon Provinces
it: 3 subcommittees set up (central and provincial / development of the state administration system and public sector personnel / national disaster management)
Appointment of advisers, academics and secretaries of the committee
Petition asking for a review of the issuing of a building permit for a project in Nonthaburi Province
Study visit and hearing on water management problems, Samut Songkhram and Samut Sakhon Provinces
Issues for further study: a national disaster management fund, zoning or expropriating land for water management, and the “Chaiyaphum Model” approach in Chaiyaphum Province, source of the Chi River

te: Names of all 3 subcommittees adjusted, and the list of staff prepared
se: The meeting approved adjusting the names of all 3 subcommittees to match their duties and powers, asked the chair of each subcommittee to propose the names of members, and asked committee members to propose the names of the committee's academics at the next meeting
it: Subcommittee names changed to: Central and Provincial Administration of State Affairs / Development of the State Administration System and Public Sector Personnel / Administration of State Affairs on National Disaster Management
The chair of each subcommittee to propose the names of subcommittee members
Committee members asked to propose names of persons to be appointed as the committee's academics

te: Work approach set, and 3 subcommittees set up
se: The meeting noted the committee's work approach under the Constitution and the Rules of Procedure of the Senate, such as the matters that come before it, requests for information for its consideration, and disclosure of information. It then approved setting up 3 subcommittees and moved its meeting day to every Wednesday
it: Work approach under the Constitution B.E. 2560 (2017) and the Rules of Procedure of the Senate B.E. 2562 (2019) as amended (No. 5) B.E. 2567 (2024)
3 subcommittees set up: central and provincial administration / development of the civil service system and public sector personnel / national disaster management
Meetings every Wednesday at 13.30 hrs

te: First meeting: election of the chair and other positions of the committee
se: At the first meeting of this committee, the meeting elected Pol.Lt.Gen. Yootana Thaipakdi as chair of the committee, together with 7 vice-chairs, a secretary, assistant secretaries, 3 spokespersons and committee advisers. It then set its initial work approach and the day and time of its weekly meetings
it: Election of the committee chair, 7 vice-chairs, a secretary, assistant secretaries, 3 spokespersons, the chair of advisers, vice-chairs of advisers and committee advisers
Appointment of 2 assistant secretaries of the committee under Rule 87, paragraph four, of the Rules of Procedure of the Senate B.E. 2562 (2019)
The Director of Committee Bureau 2, or the person acting on their behalf, to sign meeting notices on behalf of the committee secretary
The committee chair assigned as its representative on the Senate ad hoc committee on Senate affairs
The committee's contact channels
Meetings every Monday at 13.30 hrs

te: Linking the National Strategy and the development plan with the policy plans
se: Agenda: Integrating the National Strategy and the National Economic and Social Development Plan with the various levels of policy plans of the Department of Public Works and Town & Country Planning, with the Secretary-General of the National Economic and Social Development Council or a representative invited (the Senate publishes only the meeting notices of this subcommittee, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)
it: Integrating the National Strategy and the National Economic and Social Development Plan with the various levels of policy plans of the Department of Public Works and Town & Country Planning

Set the issues for discussion with the Office of the Public Sector Development Commission on improving the structure, roles, missions and workforce for town planning, in line with the Town Planning Act B.E. 2562 (2019)
